name: Glance Face Unlock
author: Ayan De
description: Face unlock with liveness detection: armed state, enrolled identities, the last scan's verdict, and a test scan, in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel for the glanced face-unlock daemon: whether it is armed, who is enrolled, what the last scan decided and why, plus arm, disarm and test-scan actions.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the daemon's status is polled while idle. The panel refreshes on open and after every action regardless.

schema.label: glancectl path
schema.description: Optional. Absolute path to glancectl. Left empty, the panel uses ~/.local/share/glance/bin/glancectl -- the venv built from glanced-0.3.4.lock, which pins all 28 packages to exact versions and SHA-256 hashes. That is the only location it will pick on its own: a pipx install, a distribution package or a source checkout resolves a dependency set nobody has reviewed, so it has to be named here deliberately rather than discovered. Whatever the path, it is checked before every run: no symlinks, every directory and the file owned by you or root and writable by nobody else, the file regular and executable, and the same file (device, inode, size, mtime) the previous run was checked against. It is then executed as the object that check accepted -- opened once and exec'd as that descriptor -- not by resolving the path again. Note what that does and does not cover: it binds the local file between check and execution, not which package versions sit behind it.
